name: Newmont Corporation
research_rationale: Filing-aligned and ~$10.1bn TTM FCF still underpin cash quality and dividends, but zero model passes and sector press on 15-month lows fit the hold screen and cap overlay conviction.

weekly_updates.summary:
Press flags gold roughly 35% below January 2026 highs and miners at 15-month lows; NEM appears in peer and recovery pieces, with rising costs and softer gold cited.
Kalkine coverage notes the 24 Nov ASX ex-date for the third-quarter dividend and Q3 2026 income focus; no new indexed filing bodies since the 4 Nov verdict.
Screening snapshot is unchanged (hold, zero model passes); file-set TTM FCF ~$10.1bn and filing-aligned ~$7.3bn are steady in sources.
